channel.title: Upcoming FreeBSD Events
channel.description: RSS feed of upcoming FreeBSD-related conferences, summits, courses, and other relevant events.

item.title: EuroBSDCon 2026
item.description: EuroBSDCon is the international annual technical conference held in a different European country each year. It focuses on gathering users and developers working on and with 4.4BSD (Berkeley Software Distribution) based operating systems family and related projects.

item.title: Open Source Experience Paris 2026
item.description: Open Source Experience (OSXP) is an event held annually in Paris and dedicated to enterprise Open Source IT solutions. The event also host booths for Open Source projects and initiatives. A FreeBSD booth will be organized by a group of contributors and users.
